invariants.rationale: The method always assigns a HoodieWriteMetadata object to 'result' before returning, never returning null.
Both code paths assign a value to result's write statuses; in the case of no taggedValidRecords, it's set to Collections.EMPTY_LIST, which is non-null.
WriteStatuses within the result list are non-null as per method construction, either returned from deleteExecutor or set to an empty list.
getWriteStatuses() is either empty or not empty; this covers all possible cases and asserts no unexpected null.
config is used unconditionally; method expects it to be non-null at exit.
